description: Source code for memory-related tools in a plugin SDK, including functions for searching and retrieving memory snippets, and tracking recall results.

methods.name: buildRecallKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key for a memory recall result based on source, path, startLine, and endLine.

methods.name: resolveRecallTrackingResults
methods.description: Resolves and merges raw and surfaced memory search results based on recall keys.

methods.name: queueShortTermRecallTracking
methods.description: Queues tracking of short-term recall results, ensuring it does not block memory recall.

methods.name: createMemorySearchTool
methods.description: Creates a tool for performing memory searches with configurable options.

methods.name: createMemoryGetTool
methods.description: Creates a tool for retrieving specific memory snippets from files.
